ValidationRule.description: A sale that is Closed Won or Closed Lost is a stored record: every field a person can edit is frozen for everyone. Only the vehicle and sale price stay open, for the vehicle change/refund flow.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), "Closed Lost") ), OR( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(CloseDate), ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(Payment_Mode__c), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(Type), ISCHANGED(CampaignId), ISCHANGED(Probability), ISCHANGED(Viewing_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Expected_Collection_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Discount_Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Fleet_Rate_Applied__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Term_Months__c), ISCHANGED(Instalment_Down_Payment__c), ISCHANGED(LeadSource), ISCHANGED(NextStep), ISCHANGED(Description), ISCHANGED(Vehicle_Model_Wanted__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This sale is closed and can't be changed. If the customer wants something different, create a new sale for them from their account; their details are already saved.
